_about: Every word the game shows, by key. {placeholders} are filled by the core. Written by the agent; listed for the person in SECOND-ORDER.md.
title: Tenth District
title.tagline: Walk Ravnica's grid, draw what each district holds, and build a deck that can face Niv-Mizzet.
title.notice: Tenth District is unofficial Fan Content permitted under the Fan Content Policy. Not approved or endorsed by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are property of Wizards of the Coast. ©Wizards of the Coast LLC.
newgame.heading: Choose the guild you start with
newgame.text: Your guild gives you a deck of its common cards and three lands in the Tenth District. Every other guild's cards can still be won.
guild.Azorius.sub: White and blue: fliers, detain, the law.
guild.Izzet.sub: Blue and red: spells, overload, experiments.
guild.Rakdos.sub: Black and red: haste, unleash, the show.
guild.Golgari.sub: Black and green: scavenge, deathtouch, rot.
guild.Selesnya.sub: Green and white: tokens, populate, the many.
story.opening: The Guildpact is gone, and the Tenth District holds its breath. Rumour in the plaza says Niv-Mizzet is testing something in Nivix, his aerie to the north-east. New Prahv keeps the writ that opens it.
quest.heading: Quests
quest.dracogenius.0: hear the rumour in the Tenth District
quest.dracogenius.1: ask New Prahv for the writ to Nivix
quest.writ.0: carry the writ to New Prahv
quest.writ.1: win a fight in an Azorius district
quest.lantern.0: find what the lantern lights in an Izzet district
quest.lantern.1: win a fight in an Izzet district
quest.lantern.2: take the lantern to New Prahv's archive
quest.festival.0: trace the curse to a Rakdos district
quest.festival.1: beat its performer in a Rakdos district
quest.festival.2: bring the cure to the Tenth District
quest.undercity.0: open the door in a Golgari district
quest.undercity.1: survive what lives there: win a fight in a Golgari district
quest.conclave.1: plant the seed in a Selesnya district
quest.conclave.2: defend the sapling: win a fight in a Selesnya district
tile.canal: a deep canal: no way through
city.tenth.text: The plaza at the heart of the district. Every guild trades here, and none of them rules it.
city.prahv.text: The Azorius Senate's three towers. The clerks keep records of everything, including where Nivix's doors are.
city.vitu.text: The Conclave's great tree-city. The Selesnya welcome anyone who will plant something.
board.grew: New streets open beyond the edge.
board.starved: You walked too long without supplies and collapsed.
reading.heading: One card, three readings
reading.kind.story: an enchantment or artifact: a story and a choice
reading.kind.magic: an instant or sorcery: a story of magic
reading.kind.land: a land: you place it on a tile you have walked
reading.tier.creature: tier {tier}: it brings {life} life and {mana} mana a turn
kw.activated: an ability it pays mana for
kw.static: a rule while it is in play
fate.heading: A fate draw
fate.shown_text: These are the cards. Shuffle them, then pick one.
effect.style: Your standing with the {guild} rises by {n}.
effect.card_deck: {card} joins your collection and your deck.
effect.fate_success: Your fate draws hold one more Success.
effect.detain_first: Each fight, the foe's best creature starts detained.
effect.start_mana: Each fight, you start with mana in the bank.
effect.extra_draw: Each fight, you start with one more card.
effect.spell_ping: Each instant or sorcery you cast deals 1 damage to the foe.
effect.opening_damage: Each fight opens with a hit on the foe.
effect.haste_first: The first creature you cast each fight has haste.
effect.regrowth: The first creature of yours to die each fight returns to your hand.
effect.marsh_walker: Swamps cost you no supplies to cross.
effect.forest_walker: Forests cost you no supplies to cross.
effect.heal_after_win: You heal after each fight you win.
effect.token_start: Each fight, you start with a Soldier at your side.
defeat.carried: You wake in {city}. Someone took {gold} gold while you were down.
land.heading: Place your land
land.text: Put it on a tile you have walked (the gold tiles). In a fight, each land within Reach {reach} of the fight's tile gives one mana of its colour each turn.
battle.withdrew: The fight drags on until your foe slips away into the crowd.
log.empty_library: {side} has no cards left, loses {n} life, and shuffles its discards back into its deck.
slot.head: head
cards.text: Cards from this city's guilds. Click one to buy it.
hall.tenth: A hall every guild sends clerks to. Quests are posted on its doors.
hall.prahv: The Senate's records hall. The writ to Nivix is kept here.
hall.vitu: The Conclave meets under the great tree.
inn.text: A warm room and a bowl of something.
trainer.text: A retired guildmage teaches what they know, for a price.
ability.reach: Long Reach: lands one tile farther feed your fights
ability.banker: Banker: start each fight with mana in the bank
deck.heading: Your deck: {n} of {max}
deck.text: Lands are not in the deck: they live on the map. Add the cards you want to fight with.
lair.sealed: Nivix's doors are sealed with Azorius wards. New Prahv keeps the writ that opens them.
lair.odds: Niv-Mizzet brings {life} life and a {deck}-card deck. You have {lands} lands within Reach.
victory.heading: Niv-Mizzet yields
victory.text: The Dracogenius folds his wings and calls the experiment finished. The first region is yours. The next guardians wait beyond its edge, in a later version of this game.
models.heading: Models, page {n} of {of}
keys.board: Arrow keys or WASD to move · click a neighbouring tile · Tab for your deck
keys.fate: Space to shuffle · 1 to 5 to pick
keys.battle: Space to pause · right arrow to step · F for speed · Enter at the end
keys.city: Press 1 to 5 for a room · Esc to leave
